SELECT l.id, l.operate_user_id, u.account AS user_account, l.operate_module, l.operate_content, l.ip, l.create_time FROM sys_log l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.operate_user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE l.is_deleted = 0
AND (l.operate_module LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY l.create_time DESC, l.id DESC
